ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the circuit there is a pair of input terminals, labeled as Zin. The upper and lower two wires form the same pair of input nodes. In the figure there are three labeled elements all connected between this same pair of upper and lower nodes: one vertical 100Ω resistor, one vertical j50Ω reactance element, and the branch on the right that goes through the upper -j50Ω element and then connects to the right vertical line and the lower wire, so -j50Ω is also equivalently connected across the same input node pair. Reasoning calculation: Treating them according to parallel impedances, the three branch impedances are respectively 100Ω, j50Ω, and -j50Ω. The input admittance is Yin = 1/100 + 1/(j50) + 1/(-j50). Among them 1/(j50) = -j/50, 1/(-j50) = j/50, the two imaginary-part admittances cancel each other, so Yin = 1/100 S. Thus Zin = 1/Yin = 100Ω.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, the equivalent input impedance \( Z_{\text{in}} \) is ________ \( \Omega \).

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit topology from the image: all three labeled elements are across the same input node pair. Treat them as parallel impedances 100 Ω, j50 Ω, and -j50 Ω. Compute the input admittance as Y_in = 1/100 + 1/(j50) + 1/(-j50). The imaginary admittances cancel, leaving Y_in = 1/100 S, so invert to obtain Z_in = 100 Ω.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：电路左侧有一对输入端子，标注为 Zin。上、下两条导线形成同一对输入节点。图中有三个标注元件都连接在这同一对上下节点之间：一个竖直的 100Ω 电阻，一个竖直的 j50Ω 电抗元件，以及右侧通过上方 -j50Ω 元件再接到右侧竖线和下方导线形成的支路，因此 -j50Ω 也等效跨接在同一输入节点对上。推理计算：按照并联阻抗处理，三个支路阻抗分别为 100Ω、j50Ω、-j50Ω。输入导纳为 Yin = 1/100 + 1/(j50) + 1/(-j50)。其中 1/(j50) = -j/50，1/(-j50) = j/50，两个虚部导纳相互抵消，所以 Yin = 1/100 S。于是 Zin = 1/Yin = 100Ω。

method.method_draft: After identifying the common top and bottom input nodes in the figure, isolate the two reactive branches: j50 Ω and -j50 Ω. Recognize that their susceptances cancel exactly, so the reactive parallel network contributes no net input admittance, behaving as an open branch. Remove that canceled branch from the equivalent circuit; the only branch left across the input is the 100 Ω resistor, so Z_in = 100 Ω.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧有两个输入端子，分别接到上方和下方的公共导线，因此这是输入端的上下两个公共节点。两条导线之间有一个竖直的 100 Ω 电阻支路；旁边还有一个竖直电感支路，标注为 j50 Ω；右上方有一个电容，标注为 -j50 Ω，其右端通过右侧竖直导线接到底部公共节点，所以该电容支路也接在同一对上下输入节点之间。推理：因此输入端看到的是 100 Ω、j50 Ω、-j50 Ω 三个并联支路。按指定方法先隔离两个无功支路：j50 Ω 的导纳为 1/(j50) = -j/50，-j50 Ω 的导纳为 1/(-j50) = j/50，两者相加为 0，说明这两个无功并联支路的总输入导纳相互抵消，等效为开路。去掉该抵消后的无功支路后，输入端只剩下 100 Ω 电阻支路，所以等效输入阻抗 Zin = 100 Ω。
